fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要分享一个冥想的故事。
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to share a meditation story.

fullTextZH: 对，以前我学了两年的瑜伽。
fullTextEN: Yes, I studied yoga for two years before.

fullTextZH: 那学瑜伽的时候，你可能要学很多东西，
fullTextEN: When learning yoga, you might have to learn many things,
For example, you need to do yoga,
And then, you also need to meditate,

fullTextZH: 然后你还要学习怎么吃得更健康，
fullTextEN: Then you also need to learn how to eat healthier,
And so on and so forth.
I need to learn many things.
But I don't like meditation,

fullTextZH: 我觉得让我什么都不做、
fullTextEN: I feel that making me do nothing,

fullTextZH: 什么都不想，是很难很难的。
fullTextEN: Thinking about nothing is very, very difficult.

fullTextZH: 所以我一直不太喜欢冥想，
fullTextEN: So I have never really liked meditation,

fullTextZH: 虽然我知道冥想对我可能很好，
fullTextEN: Although I know meditation might be good for me,
But I really don't like it,

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得我做不到什么都不想。好，
fullTextEN: Because I feel I can't think about nothing. Okay,
But there was one meditation,
I found it very interesting,

fullTextZH: 因为这一次冥想之后，我突然大哭。
fullTextEN: Because after this meditation, I suddenly cried a lot.
Then I kept crying and crying,
Cried until I couldn't stop.

fullTextZH: 那为什么这次冥想让我大哭呢？
fullTextEN: So why did this meditation make me cry so much?

fullTextZH: 因为我发现了一个东西。
fullTextEN: Because I discovered something.

fullTextZH: 那次的冥想具体什么内容，我忘了，
fullTextEN: I forgot the specific content of that meditation,
but I remember a little bit.
I remember my classmate said:
"You need to imagine
you are a baby,
a very, very small baby.
Then, because you are too small,
you can't speak,

fullTextZH: 然后你在一个什么什么地方。”
fullTextEN: and then you are in some place."
So I started to think,
I am a baby.

fullTextZH: 嗯，可能我非常小，我只有8个月大，
fullTextEN: Hmm, maybe I am very small, only 8 months old,
I can't speak.

fullTextZH: 然后呢，我一个人在那里，
fullTextEN: Then, I am there alone,

fullTextZH: 突然我发现，我被我的爸爸妈妈送走了。
fullTextEN: suddenly I realized, I was sent away by my parents.
But I can't speak,

fullTextZH: 所以我没有办法对我的爸爸妈妈说：“啊，
fullTextEN: so I have no way to say to my parents: "Ah,
don't send me away!"
While I was meditating,
I saw that baby,

fullTextZH: 然后我觉得她有一点点可怜，
fullTextEN: and then I felt she was a little pitiful,

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得她没有选择。
fullTextEN: because I felt she had no choice.
Moreover, from childhood to now,

fullTextZH: 我没有因为我被送走而生气，
fullTextEN: I was not angry about being sent away,
because I think, um,

fullTextZH: 在中国有很多很多这样的事，
fullTextEN: there are many such things in China,

fullTextZH: 然后我觉得是因为我爸爸妈妈
fullTextEN: and then I think it's because of my parents

fullTextZH: 他们的想法有一点点奇怪。
fullTextEN: that their ideas are a bit strange.
So I always feel, um,

fullTextZH: 他们把我送走可能是没有办法，
fullTextEN: that they sent me away because they had no choice,
and I also always feel, ah,
that my current family loves me very much,

fullTextZH: 所以对我来说（被送走）不是什么问题。
fullTextEN: so being sent away is not a problem for me.

fullTextZH: 我觉得我不应该很生气，
fullTextEN: I feel I shouldn't be very angry,

fullTextZH: 我应该很感恩我现在的生活。
fullTextEN: I should be very grateful for my current life.

fullTextZH: 但是，因为那一次的冥想，
fullTextEN: However, because of that meditation,
I am thinking,

fullTextZH: 是不是因为我的潜意识要保护我，
fullTextEN: is it because my subconscious wants to protect me,

fullTextZH: 所以呢，我的潜意识里告诉我自己：“啊，
fullTextEN: So, my subconscious told me: "Ah,
Don't get angry,
you should be grateful and happy.
If you are very angry,
you will hurt yourself."

fullTextZH: 对，可是因为那次的冥想，
fullTextEN: Right, but because of that meditation,

fullTextZH: 我把自己放在一个宝宝的位置上，
fullTextEN: I put myself in the position of a baby,
I felt, ah,

fullTextZH: 可能我作为一个宝宝是有一点可怜的，
fullTextEN: maybe as a baby I was a bit pitiful,
because I couldn't say anything,
no one would ask me
what my thoughts were.

fullTextZH: 我的人生已经被决定了，
fullTextEN: My life had already been decided,
so at that time,

fullTextZH: 我突然觉得非常、非常难过，
fullTextEN: I suddenly felt very, very sad,
then I started to cry.

fullTextZH: 然后我一直哭、一直哭啊，
fullTextEN: Then I kept crying, kept crying,
cried for a long time.

fullTextZH: 虽然到现在我还是不太喜欢冥想，
fullTextEN: Although I still don't really like meditation now,

fullTextZH: 但是那一次的冥想真的让我印象深刻，
fullTextEN: but that meditation really left a deep impression on me,

fullTextZH: 真的让我觉得冥想非常、非常的神奇。
fullTextEN: It really makes me feel that meditation is very, very magical.

fullTextZH: 可能它可以让我发现我内心深处的东西，
fullTextEN: Maybe it can help me discover things deep within my heart,

fullTextZH: 所以可能以后我还会再试试冥想。
fullTextEN: So maybe I will try meditation again in the future.

fullTextZH: 我觉得冥想真的值得一试。
fullTextEN: I think meditation is really worth a try.
What about you? Do you like meditation?

fullTextZH: 你有没有什么冥想的故事？
fullTextEN: Do you have any meditation stories?
You can leave a message to tell me.
Okay, thank you for listening to my story.
Then see you next time, bye!
